reason: Safari has no WebDriver emulation of prefers-color-scheme, and agents never change the macOS appearance. Each Safari session runs the OS scheme (matchMedia in the host page) plus data-theme light and dark on <html>, and skips the other media leg. At each Safari gate the owner switches macOS to dark for a second Safari pass (tests/README.md, Safari dark pass), so the two passes together run every leg.
notes: Seeded from femto's tests/divergences/rig.json (femto 65453b74), where femto verified on Safari 27.0.1 that an iframe whose embedding element has color-scheme: dark reports prefers-color-scheme: dark to matchMedia while its stylesheets and light-dark() still follow the OS, so that is not usable as emulation.
